caption: The drawing depicts a single eagle with outstretched wings, rendered in shades of brown with highlights and shading to suggest feathers and depth. The eagle's head is turned to the left, and its beak is slightly open. Positioned below and partly embraced by the eagle is a shield that features a blue upper section with white stars and a lower section of vertical red and white stripes. The eagle holds an olive branch colored in browns and muted greens in its talons, which extends outward from you the lower right of the composition. The background is entirely blank, off-white, and unadorned, providing focus to the centrally placed eagle, shield, and olive branch.
title: Stern Ornament
